Hi Dana,

Thanks again for the discovery today — great to hear more about the Crestline search assist use case and the throughput targets you mentioned (peak 200 req/s, ~10k tokens/session). To keep momentum, I put together a short proposed plan for the evaluation kickoff and a candidate prompt set so we can validate latency, cost, and quality on representative traffic.

Proposed next steps / kickoff agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: introductions + success criteria confirmation
- 15–20m: trial plan (data ingestion, prompt wiring, desired metrics)
- 10m: prompt set walkthrough and what we’ll evaluate (latency, top-k recall, hallucination checks)
- 5m: calendar + ownership + deliverables (who does what)

Attachments: trial-agenda.docx (agenda + checklist), crestline-sample-prompt-set.csv (10 representative prompts we discussed).

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Thu 2027-05-13 09:30–10:15 PT
- Thu 2027-05-13 13:00–13:45 PT
- Mon 2027-05-17 10:00–10:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate. For the kickoff we’ll include Marissa (Solutions Architect) and Ben (SE) so we can map the trial scope to a plan that runs on our hosted trial environment.

Quick ask: could you share the sample prompt set in the CSV you use internally (if different from the attached) and confirm whether the trial can use pseudonymized data or needs to be on real records? That will determine whether we spin up a dedicated tenancy.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0927

Thanks Dana — great point on measurement. I attached a short one-pager inside the calendar invite that outlines suggested two-week targets (examples below) so Anil has something to react to before the kickoff:

Suggested 2-week trial targets:
- Average p95 latency <= 350ms on your median prompt length
- End-to-end success rate (no prompt failures) >= 99.5%
- Quality: top-1 precision/recall thresholds (we’ll agree on exact prompts during the call)
- Cost estimate: projected tokens per session and estimated cost range (we’ll refine after the first run)

I also noted the Drive link where you uploaded crestline_prompts_v1.csv and attached the trial-agenda and sample prompt set again to the invite. See you Thu 2027-05-13 13:00 PT.

Cheers,
